content.short: EGGRYPTO is a free-to-own NFT role-playing game on mobile.
content.description: EGGRYPTO is a mobile free-to-own NFT role-playing game featuring an embedded self-custody wallet available during account creation. Players can download from the App Store or Google Play and start playing quickly. The game introduces a free-to-own business model in Web3 gaming that does not rely on NFTs while staying profitable and sustainable. With more than 1.5 million downloads and around 100,000 monthly active users, EGGRYPTO is one of the largest Web3 gaming communities and has continued to grow for nearly three years.
